identity_boundary: Research-attributed employment persona Naoki Murano and the historical handle supermutecx. MSMT attributes the persona to an Umnal worker named Choe Il-kuk; that participating-state attribution and its qualified activity link remain source-bound. Imagery and account status are contextual evidence; civil-identity proof requires separate source evidence.
